notes.title: Community update 2.6.0: Directly send us your maps from the level editor + 4 new official maps
notes.content:
[b]Community update 2.6.0[/b]

[h1]Additions:[/h1]
	- It is now possible to send your maps directly from the level editor: https://img4.hostingpics.net/pics/950813SendMap.png
	- 4 new official maps (City, Inverted Pyramid, Tree and Town): https://img4.hostingpics.net/pics/2490814NewMaps.jpg

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
	- To change the name of a map, go to the "maps" windows folder and rename the file "map_name.gpvr"
	- Improved Chinese translation thanks to the HTC China team
	- Improved menu rendering
	- The player is invulnerable 1s when he reappears after being caught (in case a ghost is in the same place)
	- The current game mode is saved no matter where it is changed
	- All ghosts see in their backs and can turn around (this allows proximity bombs to be used more often)
	- It is now possible to use a bonus at any time (example: you are invisible, you can use your invulnerability bonus without waiting for the end of the invisibility)

notes.title: 2.4.0 update: Introducing Steam Achievements, Trading Cards, Auto-Cloud and in-game Medals for each map.
notes.content:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
- Added a scoring system for all maps! New gold, silver and bronze medals :)
- Automatic adjustment of graphic quality according to framerate
- God Mode: Added the possibility to turn the map with both hands (a green-red laser shows up)
- Level editor: It's no longer necessary to select an object to change its texture. Point the selection area on the object and press "Texture +" or "Texture-"
- Steam Achievements (31 different achievements)
- Steam Trading Cards (6 cards, 6 badges, 5 wallpapers et 5 emoticons)
- Steam Cloud (backup of your settings as well as unofficial maps)

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- In God Mode with no motion-sickness mode on, the player's wheels were frozen
- The Game Mode option was not displayed correctly in some cases
- Ghosts could still enter the starting area in some cases
- If the player was caught in the middle of a laser-door, it remained open

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Improved visual rendering (sharpness and color)
- Faster level loading
- Ghosts can no longer enter the start zone
- Map names are more readable
- The last played map is now selected automatically
- Tutorial: The closure of the first laser-door is more explicit
- Tutorial: More readable panels
- The medals'texts are now "Gold, Silver and Bronze"
- God Mode: If the player gets caught, the camera teleports over him
- When the player gets caught, the sound is more robotic

notes.title: New fast and simple Level Editor (2.2.0 update)
notes.content:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
	- Re-design of the level editor in "God Mode": Create a map in a few seconds!
	- Added advanced creation, deletion and cloning functions, allowing to create, delete and clone in mass (keep the button pressed 1s to activate the advanced functions)
	- The "Game Mode" option is now displayed (in addition to the options) in official maps, unofficial maps and before creating a map
	- Added a visual reminder of the controls in the level editor

[h1]Bug corrections:[/h1]
	- The "GRAB" animation didn't launch

[h1]Modifications:[/h1]
	- The number of maps is now updated before pressing "Load Maps" button
	- The Oculus check now starts on the first scene with the Raf1 Dev logo
	- Modification of the camera position in "God Mode" in order to be closer to the player

New trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JH9iHKt2pFQ

notes.title: 2.1.0 update: Official maps can now be edited in the level editor!
notes.content:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
	- Official maps can now be edited in the level editor!

	- Level editor:
		=> Adding the block "Start Area" to start the map by being invincible
		=> Addition of the "glass" texture

	- Optimization:
		=> Rendering: +40% of fps on average
		=> Content: Converting maps to *.gpvr files = -1Go of data

[h1]Bug corrections:[/h1]
	- Oculus platform check fixed
	- The player could take a bonus without leaving the starting area and hide inside a ghost (well done!)
	- The teleporter's arrival wasn't displayed in "God Mode"

[h1]Modifications:[/h1]
	- When you get caught, you now respaw instead of restarting the level
	- Smoothing shadow rendering in "low" and "normal" quality
	- The ghosts' heads are ejected much further when they explode into pieces!
	- The laser-door of the start area makes you invincible only once per game
	- Tutorial upgrade (now very explicit #ArrowsEverywhere)

notes.title: 2.0.0 update is online with God Mode included!
notes.content:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]

- Ghosts explode in pieces!
- God Mode: Play in top view and move around the map like a God (compatibility with official and non-official maps)
- God Mode: New rendering according to the player's position
- God Mode:
[list]- VR: Possibility to grab the map and move it[/list]
[list]- Non-VR: The camera follows the player and can be moved with the mouse[/list]

- Menu: Addition of "Quality level", "Screen resolution", "Full screen", "Global volume" and "Game Mode"

[h1]Bug corrections:[/h1]

- In top of some stairs, it was not possible to plant WallBreaker bombs
- VR: Xbox controllers are no longer supported in VR
- It was possible to put yourself into a ghost without be detected
- Telescopic neck doesn't change the camera orientation anymore

[h1]Modifications:[/h1]

- Update of game engine, Oculus and SteamVR SDKs
- Configuration file "Game_Options.ini" can now be manually modified
- Gravity is multiplied by 19,62 - thanks to your returns, passage of a Lunar gravity in a Earth gravity
- Invisibility bonus duration is multiplied by 2

[i]As usual you can directly send me an email or leave a comment ;)[/i]

https://youtu.be/J2wA1PWn7_Y
